query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Maintain and reconcile CRM, portal, billing, and project documentation across Google Docs, Google Sheets, Zoho CRM, Google Drive, and QuickBooks while verifying live system fields and updating records.
query_ground_truth.query: read the project documentation content from google docs
query_ground_truth.rationale: An agent needs to retrieve and read the raw text content of project documentation stored in Google Docs before reconciling records.

request.query: read the project documentation content from google docs

results.use_case: read the project documentation content from google docs
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if document identifier unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Find candidate documents using GOOGLEDOCS_SEARCH_DOCUMENTS (iterate page_token/next_page_token until exhausted; tighten query if no hits).

[Required] [Prerequisite]: Confirm the intended file using GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_FILE_METADATA (verify trashed=false and that mimeType is a native document; disambiguate same-title items via metadata like owner/parent).
[Required] [Step]: Read content as plain text using GOOGLEDOCS_GET_DOCUMENT_PLAINTEXT (preferred for downstream processing; tolerate placeholders/control characters).
[Optional (if plaintext loses structure/format cues)] [Next Step]: Fetch full structure using GOOGLEDOCS_GET_DOCUMENT_BY_ID (inspect body elements, paragraphs, and styles for context).
[Optional (if edits are required)] [Next Step]: Apply changes using GOOGLEDOCS_UPDATE_EXISTING_DOCUMENT (keep updates minimal/targeted; confirm intent before writing).
[Optional (if exported bytes need normalization/bulk cleanup)] [Step]: Use COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH to fetch/decode/clean text (BOM-safe decoding, strip artifacts) before analysis.

[Fallback (if mimeType isn’t native or GOOGLEDOCS_GET_DOCUMENT_PLAINTEXT fails/insufficient)] [Fallback]: Export/download using GOOGLEDRIVE_DOWNLOAD_FILE (often returns downloaded_file_content.s3url); fetch and decode in your runtime.
known_pitfalls: [GOOGLEDOCS_SEARCH_DOCUMENTS] Results are paginated; missing page_token/next_page_token iteration can hide valid matches (IDs may appear under data.files[*].id).
[GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_FILE_METADATA] Same-title collisions are common; non-native mimeType can cause GOOGLEDOCS_* reads to fail or yield incomplete text.
[GOOGLEDOCS_GET_DOCUMENT_PLAINTEXT] Common failures include 403 PERMISSION_DENIED, 404 NOT_FOUND, 400 FAILED_PRECONDITION, 500 INTERNAL; output may include control characters or appear truncated.
[GOOGLEDOCS_GET_DOCUMENT_BY_ID] Large responses may be delivered out-of-band rather than inline; handle non-inline payloads when parsing.
[GOOGLEDRIVE_DOWNLOAD_FILE] Response often provides downloaded_file_content.s3url (not inline); exported text may include a UTF-8 BOM—decode with utf-8-sig (or equivalent).

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Collect exported download links from bulk GOOGLEDRIVE_DOWNLOAD_FILE results
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
import json
data=json.loads(raw)
pairs=[(r.get('response',{}).get('data',{}).get('downloaded_file_content',{}).get('s3url')) for r in data.get('results',[])]
pairs=[u for u in pairs if u]
```

GOOGLEDOCS_GET_DOCUMENT_PLAINTEXT.description: Retrieve a Google Doc by ID and return a best-effort plain-text rendering. Converts document structure into plain text including paragraphs, lists, and tables without requiring clients to traverse complex Docs API JSON.

tab_ids.description: Optional tab IDs to include when include_tabs_content=true. Nested child tabs are searched recursively.

document_id.description: The unique identifier for the Google Document. Accepts either a document ID (typically a 44-character alphanumeric string) or a full Google Docs URL. When a URL is provided, the document ID will be automatically extracted. Note: This parameter also accepts 'id' as an alias for consistency with other GOOGLEDOCS tools.

include_tables.description: Whether to include table content in the plain text output. Tables are rendered with configurable cell and row delimiters.

include_footers.description: Whether to include footer text in the plain text output. Footers are appended with a clear section separator.

include_headers.description: Whether to include header text in the plain text output. Headers are appended with a clear section separator.

include_footnotes.description: Whether to include footnote text in the plain text output. Footnotes are appended with a clear section separator.

table_row_delimiter.description: The delimiter to use between table rows (default: newline character).

include_tabs_content.description: When true, fetch the document using includeTabsContent=true query parameter to render all tabs. When false, only the main body content is rendered.

table_cell_delimiter.description: The delimiter to use between table cells (default: tab character).

GOOGLEDOCS_SEARCH_DOCUMENTS.description: Search for Google Documents using various filters including name, content, date ranges, and more.

query.description: Search query to filter documents. Provide either: (1) Plain text to search in document content (e.g., 'quarterly report'), which will search fullText, or (2) Drive API query syntax with operators like 'name contains', 'fullText contains', combined with 'and', 'or', 'not'. Leave empty to get all documents.

order_by.description: Order results by field. Common options: 'modifiedTime desc', 'modifiedTime asc', 'name', 'createdTime desc'

page_token.description: Token for continuing a previous search request on the next page. Use the next_page_token from the previous response to retrieve additional results.

max_results.description: Maximum number of documents to return per page (1-100). Defaults to 10. Use page_token for pagination when more results are available.

starred_only.description: Whether to return only starred documents. Defaults to False.

created_after.description: Return documents created after this date. Use RFC 3339 format like '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'.

modified_after.description: Return documents modified after this date. Use RFC 3339 format like '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'.

shared_with_me.description: Whether to return only documents shared with the current user. Defaults to False.

include_trashed.description: Whether to include documents in trash. Defaults to False.

response_detail.description: Level of detail in the response. 'minimal' returns only essential fields (id, name, modifiedTime, webViewLink) for efficient token usage. 'full' returns comprehensive metadata including permissions, owners, timestamps, and other detailed information.

include_shared_drives.description: Whether to include documents from shared drives you have access to. Defaults to True.

GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_FILE_METADATA.description: Tool to get a file's metadata by ID. Use to verify `mimeType`, `parents`, and `trashed` status before destructive operations (delete/move/export), or to confirm `mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.document'` before calling GOOGLEDOCS_* tools (non-native files require GOOGLEDRIVE_DOWNLOAD_FILE). Only returns metadata visible to the connected account; public access requires GOOGLEDRIVE_ADD_FILE_SHARING_PREFERENCE. High-frequency calls risk `403 rateLimitExceeded`; apply exponential backoff.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Use this for partial responses to request only specific metadata fields. Common fields: id, name, mimeType, webViewLink, webContentLink, createdTime, modifiedTime, size, quotaBytesUsed, parents, owners, permissions. Use '*' to return all available fields. Note: The deprecated v2 field 'alternateLink' is automatically migrated to 'webViewLink'. Example: 'id,name,mimeType,webViewLink,createdTime,modifiedTime'. Most fields (webViewLink, parents, owners, size, modifiedTime, etc.) are omitted by default — explicitly list required fields or use '*' (increases latency). `md5Checksum` is null for native Google Workspace files (Docs/Sheets/Slides); use `mimeType` to classify items — folders use `mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.folder'` and Workspace files return `size=null`. `modifiedTime` is RFC 3339 UTC format.

fileId.description: The Google Drive file ID (an opaque alphanumeric string like '1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j'), NOT a file name. If you only have a file name, use GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FILE or GOOGLEDRIVE_LIST_FILES to get the file ID first.

includeLabels.description: A comma-separated list of IDs of labels to include in the labelInfo part of the response.

supportsAllDrives.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives. Defaults to true to ensure files in shared drives are accessible.

includePermissionsForView.description: Specifies which additional view's permissions to include in the response. Only 'published' is supported.

GOOGLEDOCS_GET_DOCUMENT_BY_ID.description: Retrieves an existing Google Document by its ID; will error if the document is not found.

GOOGLEDRIVE_DOWNLOAD_FILE.description: Downloads a file from Google Drive by its ID. For Google Workspace documents (Docs, Sheets, Slides),...
